intercompany.description: Cross-company documents must use approved intercompany GL accounts.

rules.name: Balanced journal entries
rules.explanation: Policy: every journal document must have equal debit and credit totals.
rules.action: Correct the journal totals before resubmission.

rules.name: Valid general ledger account
rules.explanation: Policy: every GL account must exist in the approved GL master.

rules.name: Valid cost centre
rules.explanation: Policy: every cost centre must exist in the approved cost centre master.

rules.name: Valid company code
rules.explanation: Policy: company code and required journal fields must be present and valid.
rules.action: Complete the required fields using approved master data.

rules.name: Intercompany accounting
rules.explanation: Policy: cross-company transactions require an approved intercompany GL account.
rules.action: Use an approved intercompany GL account.

rules.name: High-value approval
rules.explanation: Policy: transactions above INR 1,000,000 require additional finance approval.
rules.action: Obtain additional finance approval before simulated posting.

rules.name: No posting with missing master data
rules.explanation: Policy: journals with missing or invalid master data must not be posted.
rules.action: Correct master data and resubmit; posting is blocked.

rules.name: Duplicate journal prevention
rules.explanation: Control: duplicate journal content must be investigated before processing.
rules.action: Verify the source document and avoid duplicate posting.

rules.name: Amount integrity
rules.explanation: Control: journal lines must contain numeric, non-negative amounts on one side only.
